en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby who said,
‘There is no problem if the man were to recite the Azān without being in ablution, but he cannot recite an Iqamah unless he was upon an ablution’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not harmful if a man says Adhan without Wudu’ but he does not say ‘Iqamah without it.’”
